title.zh-CN: 头晕不适一个多月 · 26岁男性
title.en: Dizziness for over a month · 26-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 一位年轻男性因头晕来门诊，首诊检查几乎都正常；此后他又两次带着新的症状回来——每一次都要读懂新的 MRI，判断能否下诊断、该怎样治疗。
summary.en: A young man comes to clinic with dizziness and an almost unremarkable first work-up; he later returns twice with new symptoms — each time, read the new MRI and decide whether a diagnosis can be made and how to treat.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告（影像学期刊的连续 MRI 分析）改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——26岁男性，头晕不适一个多月；首诊查体和神经电生理未见明显阳性表现，EDSS 0 分，血压 110/65 mmHg、体温 36.9 ℃；颅脑 MRI 未见明显异常，仅颈髓点状异常信号、无明显强化，常规化验无明显异常；约 10 个月后乏力、视物模糊、听力下降，EDSS 2 分，左侧侧脑室旁环形强化病灶，治疗 35 天后强化消失；再约 9 个月后症状加重伴抑郁表现，新增 6 个病灶（包括左颞叶）；脑脊液仅记为未见明显异常，无寡克隆带等详细结果；第三次发作后诊断为复发缓解型多发性硬化急性期——尚未对照原文全文核对。保留的不一致：左颞病灶一处只写“左颞叶”，另一处写作“左侧颞叶白质”；“乏力”可指肢体无力或疲乏；两段间隔（约 10 个月、再约 9 个月）的起算点不明。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（各次发作的细节、病灶大小与强化形态、第二次发作所用治疗、抗体、脑脊液细节、情绪评估、远期结局等）保持未知。三组原文 MRI 图经隐私审查批准，仅本地使用，只在复盘时展示。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report (a serial MRI analysis in an imaging journal). Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 26-year-old man with dizziness and feeling unwell for over a month; at the first visit no clear abnormality on examination or neurophysiology, EDSS 0, BP 110/65 mmHg and temperature 36.9 °C; a brain MRI without clear abnormality apart from a punctate cervical cord signal without clear enhancement, and unremarkable routine laboratory tests; about ten months later weakness, blurred vision and reduced hearing, EDSS 2 and a ring-enhancing left periventricular lesion whose enhancement had resolved after 35 days of treatment; about nine months later worsening with depressive features and six new lesions including the left temporal lobe; CSF described only as unremarkable, without oligoclonal band or other details; and a diagnosis of relapsing–remitting MS in an acute phase after the third episode — and none has yet been checked against the full article. Inconsistencies kept: the left temporal lesion is 'left temporal lobe' in one place and 'left temporal white matter' in another; 乏力 can mean limb weakness or fatigue; where the two intervals (about ten months, about nine months) are counted from is unclear. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worries (teaching devices that add no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (the details of each episode, lesion size and ring pattern, the treatment given at the second episode, antibodies, CSF details, any mood assessment, the long-term outcome) stays unknown. The report's three MRI figure groups are approved after privacy review for local use only and are shown only in the review.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按 2017 年 McDonald 标准及其 2024 年修订（Lancet Neurol 2025）读连续 MRI：判断空间多发（至少 2 个特征部位各有 ≥ 1 个病灶）和时间多发（随访 MRI 上与基线相比的新病灶），并指出本例按现行标准最早可在哪一次发作时诊断。
learningOutcomes.en: Apply dissemination in space (≥ 1 lesion in at least two characteristic regions) and in time (a new lesion on follow-up MRI against a baseline scan) from the 2017 McDonald criteria and their 2024 revision (Lancet Neurol 2025) to serial MRI, and identify the earliest episode at which this patient could be diagnosed today.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 认识到非特异的头晕加单个点状颈髓病灶既不是典型的脱髓鞘发作，也不满足空间多发：安排随访复查 MRI 并交代复诊指征，而不是诊断或用药（2024 年 McDonald 修订）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise that non-specific dizziness with a single punctate cord lesion is neither a typical demyelinating attack nor dissemination in space, and plan review with repeat MRI and safety-netting rather than a diagnosis or treatment (2024 McDonald revision).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在把新的环形强化病灶伴听力下降、视物模糊归为多发性硬化之前，完成鉴别检查——细胞法 AQP4-IgG 和 MOG-IgG（IPND 2015；国际 MOGAD 专家组 2023）、配对寡克隆带的脑脊液检查、眼科和听力评估——并在 AQP4-IgG 送检并有结果之前不开始多发性硬化的免疫治疗。
learningOutcomes.en: Before attributing a new ring-enhancing lesion with reduced hearing and blurred vision to MS, order the mimic work-up — AQP4-IgG and MOG-IgG by cell-based assay (IPND 2015; International MOGAD Panel 2023), CSF with paired oligoclonal bands, eye and hearing assessment — and hold MS immunotherapy until AQP4-IgG has been sent and its result is known.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对影响日常活动的复发，先排查感染，再在起病 14 天内给予甲泼尼龙 500 mg 口服、每日 1 次、共 5 天（口服无效、不耐受或需住院时改为 1 g 静脉、每日 1 次、共 3–5 天），并说明激素加快恢复但不是疾病修正治疗（NICE NG220，2022）。
learningOutcomes.en: Treat a relapse that affects daily activities with methylprednisolone 500 mg orally once daily for 5 days within 14 days of onset (1 g IV once daily for 3–5 days if oral treatment fails, is not tolerated or admission is needed) after looking for infection, and explain that steroids speed recovery but do not modify the disease (NICE NG220, 2022).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 确诊活动性复发型多发性硬化后，与患者共同决定尽早开始疾病修正治疗，按疾病活动度选择药物，并安排临床和 MRI 监测（ECTRIMS/EAN 2018）。
learningOutcomes.en: Once active relapsing MS is established, agree early disease-modifying therapy with the patient, matched to disease activity, with clinical and MRI monitoring (ECTRIMS/EAN 2018).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 多发性硬化患者出现抑郁表现时，筛查抑郁并直接询问轻生念头，按风险安排治疗和随访（NICE CG91，2009）。
learningOutcomes.en: When a person with MS shows depressive features, screen for depression, ask directly about suicidal thoughts, and arrange treatment and follow-up according to risk (NICE CG91, 2009).

triageNote.en: 26-year-old man at his first clinic visit with dizziness and feeling unwell for over a month. BP 110/65 mmHg, temperature 36.9 °C.

personality.zh-CN: 26岁的年轻男性，说话直接，配合检查，愿意把自己的感受讲清楚；不确定的事就说不确定，从不猜。
personality.en: A 26-year-old man, direct and cooperative, keen to explain how he feels; when he is not sure of something he says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 日常口语，句子简短，不用医学术语；说到检查只说“拍片子”“抽血”。
speechStyle.en: Everyday speech in short sentences, no medical terms; he calls the tests 'the scan' or 'blood tests'.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我头晕，人也不太舒服。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I've been dizzy and I just don't feel right.

concerns.zh-CN: 医生，我这头晕到底是怎么回事？
concerns.en: Doctor, what is actually causing this dizziness?

concerns.zh-CN: 我这病以后会不会越来越重？
concerns.en: Is this going to keep getting worse?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：首诊时他有些疑惑，想弄清头晕的原因；约 10 个月后再来时，因为看东西模糊、听不清而担心；再约 9 个月后情绪低落。只回答被问到的内容；不说任何检查结果或数字，不编造症状细节、用药、过敏或家族史。被问到是否想过伤害自己时，既不肯定也不否认，只说说不上来。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: at the first visit he is puzzled and wants to know what is causing the dizziness; about ten months later he is worried by the blurred vision and poor hearing; about nine months after that he is low in mood. He answers only what he is asked, never gives a test result or a number, and never invents symptom details, medicines, allergies or family history. Asked whether he has thought of harming himself, he neither confirms nor denies; he says he can't say.

description.zh-CN: 他第一次来门诊：头晕、人不舒服已经一个多月。采集病史，查体，安排并查看首诊检查，决定下一步。
description.en: His first clinic visit: dizziness and feeling unwell for over a month. Take the history, examine him, arrange and read the first tests, and decide what comes next.

label.zh-CN: 约 10 个月后：新的症状
label.en: About ten months later: new symptoms

description.zh-CN: 约 10 个月后，他因新的症状再次就诊。问清这次的变化，查体，复查 MRI，判断现在能否诊断、还要排除什么，并决定这次怎么治疗。
description.en: About ten months later he comes back with new symptoms. Find out what has changed, examine him, repeat the MRI, judge whether a diagnosis can be made now and what must still be excluded, and decide how to treat this episode.

label.zh-CN: 再约 9 个月后：再次复诊
label.en: About nine months later: back again

description.zh-CN: 再约 9 个月后，他又来复诊。病历中已有上次发作治疗后的复查 MRI，还有一份没有记录日期的脑脊液报告。问清这段时间的情况，复查 MRI，制订长期方案。
description.en: About nine months later he is back again. His record holds the follow-up MRI after the last episode's treatment, and a CSF report whose date is not recorded. Find out how things have gone since, repeat the MRI and set the long-term plan.

description.zh-CN: 查阅本病例记录的诊断与结局；此后的情况没有记录。
description.en: Review the diagnosis and outcome as recorded; nothing later is recorded.

name.zh-CN: 安排随访：复查颅脑和脊髓 MRI，并交代出现新症状及时复诊
name.en: Arrange review with repeat brain and spinal MRI, and advise him to return promptly with new symptoms

dose.zh-CN: 门诊随访，复查颅脑和全脊髓 MRI；告诉他出现视物模糊、肢体无力或麻木、走路不稳、排尿异常等新症状时立即复诊。
dose.en: Clinic review with repeat brain and whole-spine MRI; tell him to come back at once with blurred vision, limb weakness or numbness, unsteadiness or bladder symptoms.

response.zh-CN: 已安排随访并交代注意事项。本病例没有记录首诊后安排了什么随访；下一次有记录的评估在约 10 个月后。不模拟其效果。
response.en: Review arranged and advice given. This case does not record what follow-up was arranged after the first visit; the next recorded assessment is about ten months later. It does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 安慰并结束随诊（不再复查）

dose.zh-CN: 告诉他检查基本正常，不需要再复查或随访。
dose.en: Tell him the tests are essentially normal and he needs no further scans or review.

harm.zh-CN: 脊髓是多发性硬化的特征部位之一（2024 年 McDonald 修订，Lancet Neurol 2025），年轻人的脊髓病灶需要随访和复查 MRI；结束随诊会失去比较的基线，也错过及时评估新症状的机会。
harm.en: The spinal cord is one of MS's characteristic regions (2024 McDonald revision, Lancet Neurol 2025): a cord lesion in a young adult needs review and repeat MRI, and discharging him loses the baseline for comparison and the chance to assess new symptoms promptly.

response.zh-CN: 已告知无需随访。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；后面的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: He has been told no follow-up is needed. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 开始疾病修正治疗（长期免疫治疗）

dose.zh-CN: 与他共同选择已获批用于复发型多发性硬化的药物，疗效强度与疾病活动度相匹配；首剂前须有 AQP4-IgG 结果，并完成所选药物说明书要求的治疗前筛查（如乙型肝炎血清学）。
dose.en: Choose with him from the drugs licensed for relapsing MS, matching efficacy to disease activity; before the first dose, have the AQP4-IgG result and complete the pre-treatment screening the chosen drug's label requires (for example hepatitis B serology).

harm.zh-CN: 首诊时既没有典型发作，也不满足空间多发，此时用药是让一位可能没有多发性硬化的年轻人长期承受免疫治疗的风险（2024 年 McDonald 修订，Lancet Neurol 2025）。在送检 AQP4-IgG 之前开始多发性硬化的免疫治疗，可能漏掉 NMOSD：部分多发性硬化免疫治疗（如 β 干扰素、那他珠单抗、芬戈莫德）可使 NMOSD 加重，严重时可致盲或瘫痪；2015 年国际共识（IPND）强烈推荐用细胞法检测 AQP4-IgG。
harm.en: At the first visit there is no typical attack and no dissemination in space, so treatment would expose a young man who may not have MS to long-term immunotherapy (2024 McDonald revision, Lancet Neurol 2025). Started before AQP4-IgG has been sent, MS immunotherapy risks missing NMOSD: some MS immunotherapies (interferon beta, natalizumab, fingolimod) can make NMOSD worse, at worst with blindness or paralysis; the 2015 international criteria (IPND) strongly recommend a cell-based AQP4-IgG assay.

response.zh-CN: 已与他讨论并制订疾病修正治疗方案，AQP4-IgG 结果阴性并完成治疗前筛查后开始首剂。本病例没有记录任何疾病修正治疗（诊断前后都没有），也没有记录抗体结果，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Disease-modifying therapy has been discussed with him and planned, with the first dose once AQP4-IgG is back negative and the pre-treatment screening is complete. This case does not record any disease-modifying therapy, before or after the diagnosis, or any antibody result, and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 大剂量甲泼尼龙

dose.zh-CN: 甲泼尼龙 500 mg 口服，每日 1 次，共 5 天；口服无效或不耐受、或需住院（严重复发，或需监测躯体或心理情况）时，考虑改为甲泼尼龙 1 g 静脉滴注，每日 1 次，共 3–5 天。用药前先排查感染；用药期间注意血糖、血压、睡眠和情绪。
dose.en: Methylprednisolone 500 mg orally once daily for 5 days; consider methylprednisolone 1 g IV once daily for 3–5 days instead if oral treatment fails or is not tolerated, or if he needs admission (a severe relapse, or monitoring of a medical or psychological condition). Look for infection first; watch glucose, blood pressure, sleep and mood during the course.

harm.zh-CN: 首诊时没有需要治疗的复发，激素只带来副作用（NICE NG220，2022：激素用于影响日常活动的复发）。复发时若未先排查感染：发热或感染可以引起类似复发的“假性复发”，大剂量激素还可能加重感染。
harm.en: At the first visit there is no relapse to treat, so steroids bring only side effects (NICE NG220, 2022: steroids are for a relapse that affects daily activities). In a relapse, giving them before infection has been looked for risks treating a pseudo-relapse caused by fever or infection — and high-dose steroids can make an infection worse.

response.zh-CN: 已开具甲泼尼龙。本病例记录他第二次发作后接受过治疗，但没有记录药名、剂量和途径，也没有记录第三次发作时的治疗和任何感染筛查结果。不模拟这一医嘱的效果。
response.en: Methylprednisolone prescribed. This case records that he was treated after the second episode but not the drug, dose or route, and it does not record the treatment at the third episode or any infection-screen result. It does not simulate the effect of this order.

name.zh-CN: 小剂量泼尼松龙口服 2 周后减停
name.en: Low-dose oral prednisolone for 2 weeks, then a taper

dose.zh-CN: 泼尼松龙 30 mg 口服，每日 1 次，2 周后逐渐减停。
dose.en: Prednisolone 30 mg orally once daily for 2 weeks, then tapered off.

harm.zh-CN: NICE NG220（2022）不建议用低于甲泼尼龙 0.5 g、每日 1 次、共 5 天的激素剂量治疗复发，推荐的正是这一短程大剂量方案；小剂量长疗程只会延长激素暴露。
harm.en: NICE NG220 (2022) advises against steroid doses lower than methylprednisolone 0.5 g once daily for 5 days for a relapse and recommends that short high-dose course; a longer low-dose course only prolongs steroid exposure.

response.zh-CN: 已开具。本病例没有记录这一做法，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Prescribed. This case does not record this and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 开一疗程备用激素让他在家自行服用
name.en: A standby course of steroids for him to start at home

dose.zh-CN: 额外开一疗程甲泼尼龙，让他下次觉得复发时自己在家开始服用。
dose.en: An extra course of methylprednisolone for him to start at home whenever he next feels a relapse.

harm.zh-CN: NICE NG220（2022）指出，不应给多发性硬化患者备用激素在家自行治疗以后的复发：每次疑似复发都要由有多发性硬化经验的医生评估，排除感染和假性复发，因为并非每次复发都需要激素。
harm.en: NICE NG220 (2022) says people with MS should not be given steroids to self-treat future relapses at home: each suspected relapse needs assessment by a clinician experienced in MS, with infection and pseudo-relapse excluded, because not every relapse needs steroids.

response.zh-CN: 已开具备用药。本病例没有记录这一做法，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Standby course prescribed. This case does not record this and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 立即转介立体定向脑活检
name.en: Refer now for stereotactic brain biopsy

dose.zh-CN: 请神经外科对强化病灶行立体定向穿刺活检。
dose.en: Ask neurosurgery to take a stereotactic biopsy of the enhancing lesion.

harm.zh-CN: 活检有出血和癫痫等风险，只在影像特点、脑脊液和抗体检查等无创评估仍不能排除肿瘤、淋巴瘤或脓肿时才考虑；他有早先的颈髓病灶和多灶性症状，应先完成无创鉴别——2024 年 McDonald 修订要求的“没有更好的解释”首先靠这些检查来回答（Lancet Neurol 2025）。
harm.en: A biopsy risks bleeding and seizures and is kept for when non-invasive assessment — imaging features, CSF and antibody tests — still cannot exclude tumour, lymphoma or abscess; with an earlier cord lesion and multifocal symptoms, the non-invasive work-up comes first, since the 'no better explanation' the 2024 McDonald revision requires is answered by those tests (Lancet Neurol 2025).

response.zh-CN: 已提出转介。本病例没有记录活检，不模拟其结果。
response.en: Referral made. This case records no biopsy and does not simulate one.

name.zh-CN: 眼科和听力评估（视力、视野、眼底，纯音测听）
name.en: Eye and hearing assessment (acuity, fields, fundi; pure-tone audiometry)

dose.zh-CN: 请眼科检查视力、视野和眼底（必要时视觉诱发电位或光学相干断层成像），请耳鼻喉科行纯音测听。
dose.en: Ask ophthalmology to check acuity, fields and fundi (with visual evoked potentials or optical coherence tomography if needed), and ENT for pure-tone audiometry.

response.zh-CN: 已请会诊。本病例没有记录眼科和听力检查结果，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Assessments requested. This case records no eye or hearing results and does not simulate them.

name.zh-CN: 抑郁和自杀风险评估，并安排情绪方面的治疗和支持
name.en: Depression and suicide-risk assessment, with treatment and support for his mood

dose.zh-CN: 用抑郁筛查问卷（如 PHQ-9）评估，直接询问轻生念头和计划；按风险安排心理治疗、药物治疗或精神科会诊，并告诉他出现轻生想法时如何求助。
dose.en: Screen with a depression questionnaire (such as the PHQ-9), ask directly about suicidal thoughts and plans, arrange psychological or drug treatment or psychiatry review according to risk, and tell him where to get help if suicidal thoughts come.

response.zh-CN: 评估已安排。本病例记录了他这次有抑郁表现，但没有记录情绪评估、有无轻生念头或相应处理，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Assessment arranged. This case records depressive features at this episode but no mood assessment, suicidal thoughts or treatment, and does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 治疗期间的临床和 MRI 监测计划
name.en: Clinical and MRI monitoring plan on treatment

dose.zh-CN: 定期神经科复诊；开始或更换疾病修正治疗后先做一次参考 MRI，此后定期复查并与之比较，看有无新病灶。
dose.en: Regular neurology review; a reference MRI after starting or changing disease-modifying therapy, then regular scans compared with it for new lesions.

response.zh-CN: 已列入随访计划。本病例没有记录诊断后的随访和影像监测，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Added to the follow-up plan. This case records no follow-up or imaging after the diagnosis and does not simulate its effect.

title.en: Take the history of his dizziness

hint.zh-CN: 要判断头晕背后有没有神经系统的问题，除了头晕本身，你还需要问哪些伴随症状？
hint.en: To judge whether the dizziness points to a problem in the nervous system, which symptoms besides the dizziness itself do you need to ask about?

guidance.zh-CN: 到他身边问清头晕的情况、持续多久，以及有无听力、视力和肢体方面的症状。
guidance.en: At his side, ask about the dizziness, how long it has lasted, and any hearing, visual or limb symptoms.

title.en: Examine him and review the first tests

hint.zh-CN: 在给出诊断之前想一想：要诊断脱髓鞘疾病，对症状和受累部位的数量各有什么要求？
hint.en: Before you name a diagnosis: what does it take — in symptoms and in the number of affected regions — to call something demyelinating disease?

guidance.zh-CN: 查体并评定 EDSS，安排 MRI，查看常规化验和神经电生理报告，然后在会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Examine him and score the EDSS, arrange the MRI, read the routine blood tests and the neurophysiology report, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

hint.zh-CN: 把这次的 MRI 和首诊的放在一起看：现在受累的部位有几个？新病灶说明了什么？哪些表现又不像典型的脱髓鞘？
hint.en: Put this MRI beside the first one: how many regions are involved now, what does a new lesion tell you — and what here is not typical of demyelination?

guidance.zh-CN: 问清这次的症状，查体并评定 EDSS，复查 MRI，然后作答决策 2 和决策 3。
guidance.en: Ask about this episode, examine him and score the EDSS, repeat the MRI, then answer decisions 2 and 3.

title.zh-CN: 决定这次发作怎么治疗
title.en: Decide how to treat this episode

hint.zh-CN: 开始任何治疗之前，你要先排除什么？什么样的发作才需要治疗，用多大剂量、多长时间？
hint.en: Before any treatment, what must you exclude first — and which episodes need treating, at what dose and for how long?

guidance.zh-CN: 先问清有没有感染的表现，再在会诊板作答决策 4，并开出你的治疗。
guidance.en: Ask about signs of infection first, then answer decision 4 on the case board and order your treatment.

title.zh-CN: 回顾上次发作以来的病程
title.en: Review the course since the last episode

hint.zh-CN: 这段时间的影像和这次的变化，对长期治疗意味着什么？除了神经系统，他本人还有什么需要你关注？
hint.en: What do the scans since then and today's changes mean for long-term treatment — and beyond the nervous system, what else about him needs your attention?

guidance.zh-CN: 问清这段时间的变化和他的感受，做精神状态检查，查看治疗后复查 MRI、这次的 MRI 和脑脊液报告，然后作答决策 5。
guidance.en: Ask what has changed and how he feels, assess his mental state, read the post-treatment MRI, today's MRI and the CSF report, then answer decision 5.

title.zh-CN: 查阅记录的诊断与结局
title.en: Read the recorded diagnosis and outcome

hint.zh-CN: 记录的诊断时间和你的判断相差多久？哪些情况始终没有记录？
hint.en: How far apart are the recorded diagnosis and your own judgement — and what was never recorded?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端查阅本病例记录的诊断与结局。
guidance.en: Read the recorded diagnosis and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 26岁男性，头晕不适一个多月。查体未见明显阳性体征，EDSS 0 分；血压 110/65 mmHg，体温 36.9 ℃。MRI：颅脑未见明显异常，颈髓内点状异常信号，无明显强化；常规化验和神经电生理检查无明显异常。你的判断和下一步是什么？
prompt.en: A 26-year-old man has had dizziness and felt unwell for over a month. Examination shows no clear abnormal signs (EDSS 0); BP 110/65 mmHg, temperature 36.9 °C. MRI: no clear abnormality in the brain; a punctate signal abnormality in the cervical cord without clear enhancement. Routine blood tests and neurophysiology are unremarkable. What is your assessment and plan?

need.zh-CN: 先问清头晕的情况和病程，完成查体（含生命体征和 EDSS），并查看 MRI、常规化验和神经电生理结果。
need.en: First take the dizziness history, examine him (vital signs and EDSS included) and read the MRI, the routine blood tests and the neurophysiology.

text.zh-CN: 暂不诊断也不治疗：头晕不是典型的脱髓鞘发作，一个颈髓病灶只占一个部位；随访复查颅脑和脊髓 MRI，有新症状立即复诊
text.en: No diagnosis or treatment yet: dizziness is not a typical demyelinating attack and one cord lesion is one region — review with repeat brain and spinal MRI, and return at once with new symptoms

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。McDonald 标准针对的是典型的脱髓鞘综合征（影像孤立综合征等情形另有规定）；按 2024 年修订（Lancet Neurol 2025），空间多发需要至少 2 个特征部位各有病灶，并要有时间多发或脑脊液阳性等进一步证据。非特异的头晕、正常查体和一个颈髓病灶，既不支持诊断，也不支持治疗；但脊髓是特征部位之一，所以要随访复查 MRI，并告诉他哪些新症状要马上回来。
feedback.en: Correct. The McDonald criteria are built for a typical demyelinating syndrome (with set rules for exceptions such as radiologically isolated syndrome), and under the 2024 revision (Lancet Neurol 2025) dissemination in space needs lesions in at least two characteristic regions, with further evidence such as dissemination in time or positive CSF. Non-specific dizziness, a normal examination and one cord lesion support neither a diagnosis nor treatment — but the cord is one of those regions, so arrange review with repeat MRI and tell him which new symptoms should bring him straight back.

text.zh-CN: 可以诊断多发性硬化：颈髓是典型部位，2024 年修订允许凭 MRI 诊断，应尽早开始疾病修正治疗，以预防下一次发作、保护神经功能
text.en: Diagnose MS now: the cord is a typical site, the 2024 revision allows an MRI-based diagnosis, and disease-modifying therapy should start early to prevent the next attack and to protect function

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。2024 年修订（Lancet Neurol 2025）仍要求至少 2 个特征部位（脑室旁、皮质/近皮质、幕下、脊髓，以及新增的视神经）各有病灶，并有时间多发或脑脊液阳性等进一步证据；一个颈髓病灶只占一个部位，头晕也不是典型发作。过早诊断会让一位可能没有多发性硬化的年轻人长期承受免疫治疗的风险。
feedback.en: No. The 2024 revision (Lancet Neurol 2025) still needs lesions in at least two characteristic regions — periventricular, cortical/juxtacortical, infratentorial, spinal cord and now the optic nerve — with further evidence such as dissemination in time or positive CSF; one cord lesion is one region, and dizziness is not a typical attack. A premature label commits a young man who may not have MS to long-term immunotherapy and its risks.

text.zh-CN: 影像孤立综合征：年轻人偶然发现的脊髓病灶预示日后发病风险高，现在就开始疾病修正治疗，推迟第一次发作
text.en: Radiologically isolated syndrome: an incidental cord lesion in a young adult signals a high risk of later attacks, so start disease-modifying therapy now to delay the first one

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。影像孤立综合征是指没有典型症状的人偶然发现符合多发性硬化特点的病灶；2024 年修订只在满足空间多发并有更多证据时，才允许据此诊断多发性硬化（Lancet Neurol 2025）。一个点状颈髓病灶不满足空间多发，他的症状也还需要评估；对单个病灶用药没有依据。
feedback.en: No. Radiologically isolated syndrome means incidental, MS-typical lesions in someone without typical symptoms, and the 2024 revision allows MS to be diagnosed from it only when dissemination in space is met with further evidence (Lancet Neurol 2025). One punctate cord lesion does not meet dissemination in space, and his symptom still needs assessing; there is no basis for treating a single lesion.

text.zh-CN: 安慰后结束随诊：颅脑 MRI 正常，年轻人颈髓一个点状信号多为非特异性改变，头晕对症处理即可，不必复查或随访
text.en: Reassure and discharge: the brain MRI is normal, one punctate cord signal in a young man is usually non-specific, and beyond easing the dizziness no repeat scan or clinic review is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。脊髓是多发性硬化的特征部位之一（2024 年修订，Lancet Neurol 2025），年轻人的脊髓病灶不能当作无意义的发现而结束随诊。应随访复查 MRI，并告诉他视物模糊、肢体无力或麻木、走路不稳等新症状要尽快复诊。
feedback.en: No. The spinal cord is one of MS's characteristic regions (2024 revision, Lancet Neurol 2025), so a cord lesion in a young adult is not a finding to discharge. Arrange review with repeat MRI and tell him that blurred vision, limb weakness or numbness, or unsteadiness should bring him back promptly.

text.zh-CN: 按首次脱髓鞘事件处理：现在给予大剂量甲泼尼龙 3–5 天，结束后复查 MRI，看颈髓信号有没有改善
text.en: Treat as a first demyelinating event: high-dose methylprednisolone for 3–5 days now, then repeat the MRI to see whether the cord signal has improved

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。大剂量甲泼尼龙用于影响日常活动的复发，目的是加快恢复（NICE NG220，2022），不是用来处理一个没有对应症状的影像发现，治疗反应也证明不了病灶的性质。现在既没有需要治疗的发作，也没有诊断，用激素只带来副作用。
feedback.en: No. High-dose methylprednisolone treats a relapse that affects daily activities, to speed recovery (NICE NG220, 2022); it is not for an imaging finding without matching symptoms, and the response would prove nothing about the lesion. With no attack to treat and no diagnosis, steroids now bring only side effects.

prompt.zh-CN: 约 10 个月后，他出现乏力、视物模糊和听力下降，EDSS 2 分。这次 MRI：左侧侧脑室旁环形强化病灶。首诊 MRI 只有颈髓点状异常信号，颅脑未见明显异常。按现行的多发性硬化诊断标准，这些发现意味着什么？
prompt.en: About ten months later he has weakness, blurred vision and reduced hearing; EDSS 2. This MRI shows a ring-enhancing lesion beside the left lateral ventricle (left periventricular). The first MRI showed only the punctate cervical cord signal, with no clear abnormality in the brain. Against today's MS diagnostic criteria, what do these findings mean?

need.zh-CN: 先问清这次的症状，查体并评定 EDSS，再查看这次的 MRI。
need.en: First ask about this episode, examine him and score the EDSS, then read this episode's MRI.

text.zh-CN: 很可能已是多发性硬化：脑室旁加脊髓为空间多发，较首诊新出现的病灶为时间多发——前提是鉴别检查找不到更好的解释
text.en: Probably MS now: periventricular plus cord lesions give dissemination in space and a lesion new since the first scan gives it in time — unless the mimic work-up finds a better explanation

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。按 2017 年 McDonald 标准（Lancet Neurol 2018）及其 2024 年修订（Lancet Neurol 2025），至少 2 个特征部位各有 ≥ 1 个病灶即为空间多发；随访 MRI 上与基线相比出现的新 T2 或强化病灶即为时间多发，与基线检查做了多久无关。左侧脑室旁的新病灶加上首诊的颈髓病灶同时满足两者；但听力下降和环形强化不典型，诊断要以排除其他疾病为前提。
feedback.en: Correct. Under the 2017 McDonald criteria (Lancet Neurol 2018) and their 2024 revision (Lancet Neurol 2025), ≥ 1 lesion in at least two characteristic regions gives dissemination in space, and a new T2 or enhancing lesion on follow-up MRI compared with a baseline scan — whenever that scan was done — gives dissemination in time. His new left periventricular lesion with the earlier cord lesion meets both; but reduced hearing and ring enhancement are atypical, so the diagnosis stands only once other causes have been excluded.

text.zh-CN: 还不能诊断：只有两个部位、两个病灶，证据太少，应等再一次发作或出现更多新病灶后再诊断，这也是早年诊断标准的做法
text.en: Not yet: two regions and only two lesions are too little evidence, so wait for another attack or for several more new lesions before making the diagnosis, as the earlier criteria required

feedback.zh-CN: 这接近报告当年所用的 2005 年标准的思路，但已不是现行标准。2010 年修订（Ann Neurol 2011）就把空间多发简化为 4 个部位中至少 2 个各有 ≥ 1 个 T2 病灶，并接受随访 MRI 上的新病灶（不论基线检查做于何时）作为时间多发；2017 年标准和 2024 年修订沿用了这一点。等待第三次发作会推迟诊断和疾病修正治疗。
feedback.en: This is close to the 2005 criteria the report applied, but it is no longer the standard. The 2010 revision (Ann Neurol 2011) already reduced dissemination in space to ≥ 1 T2 lesion in at least two of four regions and accepted a new lesion on follow-up MRI, whenever the baseline scan was done, as dissemination in time; the 2017 criteria and the 2024 revision kept this. Waiting for a third attack delays the diagnosis and disease-modifying therapy.

text.zh-CN: 还不能诊断：必须先做腰椎穿刺，脑脊液查到寡克隆带才能确诊，结果出来之前只能当作可疑病例
text.en: Not yet: a lumbar puncture must first show CSF-specific oligoclonal bands, and until that result is back this can only be called a possible case of MS

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。按 2017 年标准（Lancet Neurol 2018），脑脊液特异性寡克隆带可以替代时间多发，2024 年修订（Lancet Neurol 2025）又接受 κ 游离轻链指数；但 MRI 已证明时间多发时，它们不是诊断的必要条件。腰椎穿刺仍值得做，用来寻找其他疾病，但诊断不必等它。
feedback.en: No. Under the 2017 criteria (Lancet Neurol 2018) CSF-specific oligoclonal bands can stand in for dissemination in time, and the 2024 revision (Lancet Neurol 2025) also accepts the kappa free light chain index; neither is required when MRI already shows dissemination in time. A lumbar puncture is still worth doing, to look for other causes, but the diagnosis does not wait for it.

text.zh-CN: 不支持脱髓鞘：环形强化病灶首先要当作肿瘤或脓肿，在任何其他处理之前，先安排立体定向活检明确性质
text.en: Not demyelination: a ring-enhancing lesion has to be treated as a tumour or an abscess until proven otherwise, so a stereotactic biopsy should come before anything else is done

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。环形强化确实要考虑肿瘤、淋巴瘤或脓肿，但要先结合病灶的大小、强化环形态、占位效应和弥散（本病例均未记录），以及临床经过和无创检查来判断；活检有出血和癫痫风险，只在无创评估仍不能排除时才做。2024 年修订（Lancet Neurol 2025）要求的“没有更好的解释”，首先靠系统的鉴别检查来回答。
feedback.en: No. Ring enhancement does raise tumour, lymphoma or abscess, but it is judged first by the lesion's size, ring pattern, mass effect and diffusion (none recorded here), the clinical course and non-invasive tests; a biopsy risks bleeding and seizures and is kept for when that assessment cannot exclude them. The 'no better explanation' the 2024 revision (Lancet Neurol 2025) requires is answered first by a structured work-up.

text.zh-CN: 应诊断视神经脊髓炎谱系疾病：视物模糊加脊髓病灶已经足够，不必再考虑多发性硬化的诊断和治疗
text.en: This is NMOSD: blurred vision together with a spinal cord lesion is enough for that diagnosis, so MS and its disease-modifying treatment no longer need considering

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。按 2015 年国际共识（IPND，Neurology 2015），NMOSD 的诊断依靠细胞法检测的 AQP4-IgG；抗体阴性或未检测时，需要满足更严格的临床和 MRI 条件。一个点状颈髓信号不是 NMOSD 典型的长节段脊髓炎，应先送检抗体再下结论。
feedback.en: No. Under the 2015 international criteria (IPND, Neurology 2015), NMOSD rests on AQP4-IgG detected by a cell-based assay, with stricter clinical and MRI requirements when it is negative or untested. A punctate cord signal is not the long-segment myelitis typical of NMOSD; send the antibodies before drawing that conclusion.

prompt.zh-CN: 他这次有听力下降和视物模糊，MRI 见环形强化病灶。在把这次发作归为脱髓鞘之前，你需要做哪些检查？（多选）
prompt.en: This time he has reduced hearing and blurred vision, and the MRI shows a ring-enhancing lesion. Before you attribute this episode to demyelination, which tests do you need? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先问清这次的症状，并查看这次的 MRI。
need.en: First ask about this episode's symptoms and read this episode's MRI.

text.zh-CN: 血清 AQP4-IgG 和 MOG-IgG（细胞法检测）
text.en: Serum AQP4-IgG and MOG-IgG by cell-based assay

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。2015 年 NMOSD 国际共识（IPND，Neurology 2015）强烈推荐用细胞法检测 AQP4-IgG；MOG-IgG 是 2023 年国际 MOGAD 专家组标准（Lancet Neurol 2023）的核心条件。视物模糊加脊髓病灶正是需要排除这两种疾病的情形，而且部分多发性硬化免疫治疗可使 NMOSD 加重。本病例没有记录这两项结果。
feedback.en: Needed. The 2015 international NMOSD criteria (IPND, Neurology 2015) strongly recommend a cell-based assay for AQP4-IgG, and MOG-IgG is the core criterion of the 2023 International MOGAD Panel criteria (Lancet Neurol 2023). Blurred vision with a cord lesion is exactly when both must be excluded — and some MS immunotherapies can make NMOSD worse. The case records neither result.

text.zh-CN: 腰椎穿刺：脑脊液细胞数、蛋白和寡克隆带（同时送配对血清）
text.en: Lumbar puncture: CSF cell count, protein and oligoclonal bands, with a paired serum sample

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。脑脊液可以发现感染或其他炎症性疾病；按 2017 年标准（Lancet Neurol 2018），只出现在脑脊液而不出现在血清中的寡克隆带才算阳性，所以要送配对血清，2024 年修订（Lancet Neurol 2025）还接受 κ 游离轻链指数。腰椎穿刺前先在 MRI 上确认强化病灶没有明显占位效应。本病例的脑脊液记录随后续病程展示，检查日期没有记录。
feedback.en: Needed. CSF can show infection or another inflammatory disease, and under the 2017 criteria (Lancet Neurol 2018) oligoclonal bands count only when present in CSF but not in serum — hence the paired sample; the 2024 revision (Lancet Neurol 2025) also accepts the kappa free light chain index. Before the lumbar puncture, check the MRI for mass effect from the enhancing lesion. This case's CSF record appears with the later course, and its date is not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 眼科检查（视力、视野、眼底）和纯音测听
text.en: An eye examination (acuity, fields, fundi) and pure-tone audiometry

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。2024 年修订（Lancet Neurol 2025）把视神经列为第五个特征部位，客观的眼科评估可能改变受累部位的计数；听力下降在多发性硬化中少见，要用测听客观评估——Susac 综合征就同时有听力下降、视觉症状和脑白质病灶。本病例没有记录眼科和听力检查结果。
feedback.en: Needed. The 2024 revision (Lancet Neurol 2025) makes the optic nerve a fifth characteristic region, so an objective eye assessment can change the count; reduced hearing is uncommon in MS and needs audiometry — Susac syndrome combines hearing loss, visual symptoms and white-matter lesions. The case records no eye or hearing results.

text.zh-CN: 先做立体定向脑活检，弄清病灶性质后再决定其他检查
text.en: A stereotactic brain biopsy first, to settle what the lesion is before other tests

feedback.zh-CN: 不应作为第一步。活检有出血和癫痫风险，只在影像特点、脑脊液和抗体检查仍不能排除肿瘤、淋巴瘤或脓肿时才考虑；2024 年修订（Lancet Neurol 2025）要求的“没有更好的解释”，首先靠这些无创检查来回答。
feedback.en: Not as a first step. A biopsy carries risks of bleeding and seizures and is kept for when imaging features, CSF and antibody tests still leave tumour, lymphoma or abscess open; the 'no better explanation' the 2024 revision (Lancet Neurol 2025) requires is answered first by these non-invasive tests.

text.zh-CN: 暂不做其他检查：观察症状，6 个月后复查颅脑 MRI
text.en: No further tests now: watch the symptoms and repeat the brain MRI in six months

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。有新症状、新的强化病灶和不典型表现时，等 6 个月会同时推迟鉴别诊断和治疗；NICE NG220（2022）要求对需要治疗的复发在起病 14 天内开始治疗，鉴别检查应在这次就诊时完成。
feedback.en: No. With new symptoms, a new enhancing lesion and atypical features, six months of waiting delays both the differential diagnosis and treatment; NICE NG220 (2022) expects a relapse that needs treatment to be treated within 14 days of onset, and the work-up belongs to this visit.

prompt.zh-CN: 这次发作有乏力、视物模糊和听力下降，EDSS 2 分，MRI 见新的环形强化病灶。他有没有发热或感染，本病例没有记录。这次发作你打算怎么治疗？
prompt.en: This episode brings weakness, blurred vision and reduced hearing, with EDSS 2 and a new ring-enhancing lesion. Whether he has a fever or an infection is not recorded. How will you treat this episode?

need.zh-CN: 先问清这次的症状，查体评定 EDSS，并查看这次的 MRI。
need.en: First ask about this episode, score the EDSS and read this episode's MRI.

text.zh-CN: 若影响日常活动：先排查感染，再用甲泼尼龙 500 mg 口服、每日 1 次、共 5 天（必要时改静脉）
text.en: If it affects his daily life: look for infection first, then methylprednisolone 500 mg orally once daily for 5 days (IV if needed)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。NICE NG220（2022）对影响日常活动的复发，在起病 14 天内给予甲泼尼龙 0.5 g 口服、每日 1 次、共 5 天；口服无效或不耐受、严重复发需住院或需监测躯体或心理情况时，考虑甲泼尼龙 1 g 静脉、每日 1 次、共 3–5 天。用激素前先排查感染，因为发热和感染可以引起类似复发的“假性复发”。激素加快恢复，但不是疾病修正治疗。
feedback.en: Correct. NICE NG220 (2022) offers methylprednisolone 0.5 g orally once daily for 5 days, within 14 days of onset, for a relapse that affects daily activities, and considers 1 g IV once daily for 3–5 days when oral steroids fail or are not tolerated, or admission is needed for a severe relapse or for medical or psychological monitoring. Look for infection first: fever and infection can cause a pseudo-relapse. Steroids speed recovery; they do not modify the disease.

text.zh-CN: 为减少副作用，给泼尼松龙 30 mg 口服、每日 1 次、共 2 周，之后逐渐减停，不用大剂量疗程
text.en: To limit side effects, prednisolone 30 mg orally once daily for 2 weeks and then a slow taper, in place of a short high-dose course

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。NICE NG220（2022）不建议用低于甲泼尼龙 0.5 g、每日 1 次、共 5 天的激素剂量治疗复发，推荐的正是这一短程大剂量方案。小剂量长疗程反而延长了激素暴露。
feedback.en: No. NICE NG220 (2022) advises against steroid doses lower than methylprednisolone 0.5 g once daily for 5 days for a relapse and recommends that short high-dose course instead. A longer low-dose course only prolongs steroid exposure.

text.zh-CN: 不用激素：激素不能改变远期残疾，所以每一次发作都应让它自行恢复，只做对症处理
text.en: No steroid: steroids do not change long-term disability, so every attack should be left to recover on its own with symptom relief only

feedback.zh-CN: 不完全对。NICE NG220（2022）承认并非每次复发都需要激素，但影响日常活动的复发应在起病 14 天内给予甲泼尼龙，以加快恢复。把“不改变远期残疾”当作一律不治疗的理由，会让他承受本可缩短的功能障碍。
feedback.en: Not quite. NICE NG220 (2022) accepts that not every relapse needs steroids, but one that affects daily activities should be offered methylprednisolone within 14 days of onset to speed recovery. Using 'no effect on long-term disability' as a reason never to treat leaves him with a disability that could have been shortened.

text.zh-CN: 先排查感染，再用甲泼尼龙 500 mg 口服、每日 1 次、共 5 天，另开一疗程备在家里，下次发作时自己先吃
text.en: Look for infection first, then methylprednisolone 500 mg orally once daily for 5 days, plus a spare course to keep at home and start himself at the next relapse

feedback.zh-CN: 前半部分正确，但 NICE NG220（2022）指出，不应给患者备用激素在家自行治疗以后的复发：每次疑似复发都要由有多发性硬化经验的医生评估，先排除感染和假性复发，因为并非每次复发都需要激素。
feedback.en: The first half is right, but NICE NG220 (2022) says people should not be given steroids to self-treat future relapses at home: each suspected relapse needs assessment by a clinician experienced in MS, with infection and pseudo-relapse excluded first, because not every relapse needs steroids.

prompt.zh-CN: 又过了约 9 个月：他说症状又加重了，心情低落，查体有抑郁表现。上次治疗 35 天后复查 MRI，强化已消失；这次 MRI 新增 6 个病灶，包括左侧颞叶；脑脊液报告“未见明显异常”，没有寡克隆带结果。多发性硬化现在是工作诊断。长期方案应包括哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: About nine months on, he says his symptoms are worse again and he feels low, with depressive features on examination. After 35 days of treatment last time the enhancement had gone; this MRI shows six new lesions, including the left temporal lobe; the CSF report says 'unremarkable', with no oligoclonal band result. MS is now the working diagnosis. What should the long-term plan include? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先问清这段时间的变化和他的心情，做精神状态检查，并查看治疗后复查 MRI、这次的 MRI 和脑脊液报告。
need.en: First ask what has changed and about his mood, assess his mental state, and read the post-treatment MRI, this MRI and the CSF report.

text.zh-CN: 现在就与他共同决定疾病修正治疗，按疾病活动度选药：尚未用药就开始，已在用药则换用更有效的药物
text.en: Decide on disease-modifying therapy with him now, matched to this activity: start one if he is not on treatment, or move to a more effective drug if he is

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。ECTRIMS/EAN 指南（Mult Scler 2018）主张活动性复发型多发性硬化尽早开始疾病修正治疗，按疾病活动度、安全性和患者意愿共同选择。约 9 个月内再次复发并新增 6 个病灶，说明病程活动。开始前要有 AQP4-IgG 结果，并完成所选药物要求的治疗前筛查。
feedback.en: Needed. The ECTRIMS/EAN guideline (Mult Scler 2018) favours early disease-modifying therapy in active relapsing MS, chosen with the patient by disease activity, safety and preference. A further relapse with six new lesions within about nine months is active disease. Before starting, have the AQP4-IgG result and complete the pre-treatment screening the chosen drug requires.

text.zh-CN: 筛查抑郁，直接询问有没有轻生念头，并为他的情绪安排治疗和支持
text.en: Screen for depression, ask him directly about thoughts of suicide, and arrange treatment and support for his mood

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。NICE CG91（2009，慢性躯体疾病合并抑郁）要求对慢性躯体疾病患者保持对抑郁的警觉并主动筛查。出现抑郁表现时要直接询问轻生念头，回答含糊不能当作没有，并按风险安排治疗和随访。本病例没有记录他是否有轻生念头。
feedback.en: Needed. NICE CG91 (2009, depression with a chronic physical health problem) asks clinicians to stay alert to depression in chronic physical illness and to screen for it. With depressive features, ask directly about suicidal thoughts, do not take a vague answer as a no, and arrange treatment and follow-up by risk. The case does not record whether he has such thoughts.

text.zh-CN: 定期临床随访和 MRI 复查，开始或更换治疗后先做一次参考 MRI
text.en: Regular clinical review and MRI, with a reference scan after starting or changing treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。ECTRIMS/EAN 指南（Mult Scler 2018）主张结合临床和 MRI 监测治疗中患者的疾病活动，开始治疗后的参考 MRI 是此后比较的基线。这样下一个新病灶才能被及时发现，并据此调整治疗。
feedback.en: Needed. The ECTRIMS/EAN guideline (Mult Scler 2018) combines clinical review with MRI to monitor disease activity on treatment, and the reference scan after treatment starts is the baseline for later comparison. Only then is the next new lesion seen in time and treatment adjusted.

text.zh-CN: 每次复发用一疗程激素即可；激素已能缩短每次发作，等残疾开始累积后再考虑疾病修正治疗
text.en: A course of steroids for each relapse; since steroids already shorten each attack, keep disease-modifying therapy until disability starts to build up

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。激素只加快单次复发的恢复（NICE NG220，2022），不能减少以后的复发和新病灶；ECTRIMS/EAN 指南（Mult Scler 2018）主张活动性病程尽早开始疾病修正治疗，而不是等到残疾已经累积。
feedback.en: No. Steroids only speed recovery from a single relapse (NICE NG220, 2022) and do not prevent further relapses or new lesions; the ECTRIMS/EAN guideline (Mult Scler 2018) favours early disease-modifying therapy in active disease rather than waiting for disability to accumulate.

text.zh-CN: 情绪低落是这次复发的一部分，激素治疗后会随之好转，不需要单独评估
text.en: The low mood is part of this relapse and will lift with steroid treatment, so it needs no separate assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。抑郁需要单独评估和处理（NICE CG91，2009），不能默认会随复发好转；大剂量激素本身也可能影响情绪。不评估，就可能漏掉轻生风险。
feedback.en: No. Depression needs its own assessment and treatment (NICE CG91, 2009) and cannot be assumed to lift with the relapse; high-dose steroids can themselves affect mood. Without an assessment, a risk of suicide can be missed.

text.zh-CN: 问清头晕的病程及听力、视力、肢体症状和既往发作；之后两次问清新症状、有无感染和上次的治疗
text.en: Took the dizziness history with hearing, visual and limb symptoms and earlier episodes, then at each return the new symptoms, any infection and the previous treatment

text.zh-CN: 首诊查体、评定 EDSS 并测量生命体征，第二次再评定 EDSS，第三次检查精神状态
text.en: Examined him with an EDSS and vital signs at the first visit, scored the EDSS again at the second and assessed his mental state at the third

text.zh-CN: 逐次查看决定性的记录：三次 MRI、治疗后复查 MRI、首诊化验和神经电生理，以及脑脊液报告
text.en: Read the decisive records in turn: the three MRIs, the post-treatment MRI, the first visit's blood tests and neurophysiology, and the CSF report

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断首诊既不能诊断也不该治疗，安排了随访和复查 MRI，没有直接结束随诊
text.en: Judged at the first attempt that the first visit supported neither a diagnosis nor treatment, arranged review with repeat MRI and did not discharge him

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即按现行标准判断第二次发作时已满足空间和时间多发
text.en: Recognised at the first attempt that the second episode met dissemination in space and time under today's criteria

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对鉴别检查，在第二次发作时送检 AQP4/MOG 抗体、请眼科和听力评估，没有先去活检
text.en: Chose the mimic work-up at the first attempt, sent AQP4 and MOG antibodies and requested eye and hearing assessment at the second episode, and did not go to biopsy first

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对复发治疗，排查感染后才给足量甲泼尼龙，没有用小剂量激素或开备用激素
text.en: Chose the relapse treatment at the first attempt and gave full-dose methylprednisolone only after an infection screen, with no low-dose course and no home supply

text.zh-CN: 第二次发作时、送检 AQP4/MOG 抗体之后，就制订并启动了疾病修正治疗
text.en: Planned disease-modifying therapy at the second episode, after sending AQP4 and MOG antibodies

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制订长期方案，并安排了临床和 MRI 监测
text.en: Set the long-term plan at the first attempt and arranged clinical and MRI monitoring

text.zh-CN: 没有在首诊时、也没有在送检 AQP4 抗体之前启动疾病修正治疗
text.en: Started or planned no disease-modifying therapy at the first visit, or before AQP4 antibodies had been sent

text.zh-CN: 第三次就诊时直接询问轻生念头，并安排了抑郁和自杀风险评估
text.en: At the third visit asked directly about suicidal thoughts and arranged a depression and suicide-risk assessment

text.zh-CN: 向他说明不确定性、诊断和治疗选择，并关注他的情绪
text.en: Explained the uncertainty, the diagnosis and the treatment choices to him, and attended to his mood

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、采集信息、解释与计划、结束）：首诊时先了解他对头晕的想法和担心，用通俗的话说明 MRI 上颈髓的一个小点现在还不能下任何诊断，也不需要治疗，讲清为什么要随访复查、哪些新症状要立即回来；第二次时坦诚说明这很可能是多发性硬化，但还要做抗体、脑脊液、眼科和听力检查排除别的病，解释激素的用法、作用和副作用（血糖、睡眠、情绪），以及长期治疗的选择，请他参与决定；第三次时留出时间询问他的情绪，敏感而直接地问是否有轻生念头，回答含糊时不轻易放过，并约定支持和随访。全程用复述确认理解，不作虚假保证，不编造病例中没有的结果。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering information, explaining and planning, closing): at the first visit, elicits his ideas and worries about the dizziness, explains in plain words that one small spot in the spinal cord in his neck does not yet mean any diagnosis or need any treatment, and why he will be reviewed and which new symptoms should bring him straight back; at the second, says honestly that this is probably MS but that antibody, CSF, eye and hearing tests are needed to exclude other conditions, explains the steroid course — what it does and its effects on glucose, sleep and mood — and the long-term treatment choices, which he helps decide; at the third, makes time to ask about his mood, asks directly and sensitively about suicidal thoughts and does not let a vague answer pass, and agrees support and follow-up. Checks understanding by teach-back throughout, gives no false reassurance and invents no result the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 严护士

knowledge.zh-CN: 首诊交班（ISBAR）：26岁男性，门诊首诊，头晕不适一个多月；记录的血压 110/65 mmHg，体温 36.9 ℃。诊室可做床旁查体；抽血在患者身边进行；MRI 和 CT 在影像科，她可以陪他走过去；护士站有病历终端，可调阅既往报告和会诊记录；药物由药房送到床旁。复述医嘱，只做护理范围内的事；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断。被问到心率、体重或其他没有记录的数值时，如实说没有记录，绝不报数字。之后两次复诊时，她只说明他又来就诊，不预先透露症状或检查结果。
knowledge.en: First-visit handover (ISBAR): a 26-year-old man at his first clinic visit with dizziness and feeling unwell for over a month; recorded BP 110/65 mmHg, temperature 36.9 °C. The consulting room allows a bedside examination; blood is taken at his side; MRI and CT are in imaging, and she can walk him there; the nurses' station has a records terminal for earlier reports and consultation notes; medicines come from the pharmacy to the bedside. Reads orders back and does only nursing-scope tasks; reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for a heart rate, a weight or any other value that is not recorded, says plainly there is none — never gives a number. At his later visits she says only that he is back, without anticipating his symptoms or results.

name.zh-CN: 冯医生（神经内科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“什么样的症状才算典型的脱髓鞘发作？头晕算吗？”“一个病灶占几个特征部位？诊断至少要几个？”“随访 MRI 出现了基线上没有的病灶，说明了什么？”“哪些表现在多发性硬化里少见，会让你去找别的病？”“开始多发性硬化的药物之前，为什么要先查 AQP4 抗体？”“用激素之前要先排除什么？”“强化消失说明病好了吗？”“如果单个强化病灶让你真的怀疑淋巴瘤，活检之前用激素会有什么问题？”“除了神经系统，他本人还有什么需要你关注？”。可以讲解 2017 年 McDonald 标准及其 2024 年修订（2010 年修订已把空间多发简化为 4 个部位中至少 2 个）、2015 年 NMOSD 国际共识和 2023 年 MOGAD 标准、NICE NG220（2022）的复发治疗、ECTRIMS/EAN 2018 年指南的疾病修正治疗原则，以及 NICE CG91（2009）对慢性躯体疾病合并抑郁的要求；学员读过结局记录后，可以对比记录的病程与现行标准。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项，不说出学员尚未读到的结果；不补充病例中没有的资料（首诊头晕的性质、各次发作的细节、EDSS 分项、病灶大小和强化形态、治疗的药名剂量、抗体和脑脊液细节、情绪评估和远期结局都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. 'What makes an episode a typical demyelinating attack — is dizziness one?', 'How many characteristic regions does one lesion occupy, and how many does the diagnosis need?', 'If a follow-up MRI shows a lesion the baseline scan did not have, what does that establish?', 'Which features are uncommon in MS and should send you looking for something else?', 'Why test AQP4 antibodies before any MS drug?', 'What must you exclude before giving steroids?', 'Does loss of enhancement mean the disease has gone?', 'If a single enhancing lesion really made you suspect lymphoma, what would steroids before a biopsy do?', 'Beyond his nervous system, what else about him needs your attention?'. May explain the 2017 McDonald criteria and their 2024 revision (the 2010 revision had already reduced dissemination in space to at least two of four regions), the 2015 international NMOSD criteria and the 2023 MOGAD criteria, relapse treatment in NICE NG220 (2022), the disease-modifying principles of the ECTRIMS/EAN guideline (2018) and NICE CG91 (2009) on depression with a chronic physical illness; once the learner has read the outcome record, may contrast the recorded course with current criteria. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, never gives a result the learner has not read, and adds nothing the case does not record (the nature of the first dizziness, the details of each episode, the EDSS sub-scores, lesion size and ring pattern, the treatment's drug and dose, antibody and CSF details, a mood assessment and the long-term outcome are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 邵医生（放射科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 放射科医生，只解读学员已经读过的 MRI 报告：说明多发性硬化的特征部位（脑室旁、皮质/近皮质、幕下、脊髓，以及 2024 年修订新增的视神经），空间多发和时间多发在影像上怎样判断，为什么随访 MRI 要和基线比较；环形强化的鉴别——一般而言，不完整的开环强化更支持脱髓鞘，完整的闭环、明显的占位效应或弥散受限更需要考虑肿瘤或脓肿——并说明本病例没有记录病灶大小、强化环形态、占位效应和弥散表现；强化消失只表示病灶不再处于活动期。不报告学员尚未读到的结果，不编造序列表现、病灶大小或位置（各次 MRI 只有报告的文字所见）。
knowledge.en: Radiologist who interprets only the MRI reports the learner has read: the characteristic MS regions (periventricular, cortical/juxtacortical, infratentorial, spinal cord, and — new in the 2024 revision — the optic nerve), how dissemination in space and in time are judged on imaging, and why a follow-up scan is compared with a baseline; the differential of ring enhancement — in general an incomplete, open ring favours demyelination, while a complete ring, marked mass effect or restricted diffusion keeps tumour or abscess in view — adding that this case records none of the lesion's size, ring pattern, mass effect or diffusion; and that loss of enhancement means only that a lesion is no longer active. Never reports a result the learner has not read and never invents sequences, sizes or locations (each MRI exists only as the report's written findings).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：连续 MRI 与多发性硬化的诊断时机
title.en: Debrief: serial MRI and the timing of a multiple sclerosis diagnosis

conclusion.zh-CN: 26岁男性，头晕不适一个多月。查体和神经电生理检查未见明显异常（EDSS 0 分；血压 110/65 mmHg，体温 36.9 ℃），常规化验无明显异常，颅脑 MRI 未见明显异常，仅颈髓点状异常信号、无明显强化。约 10 个月后出现乏力、视物模糊和听力下降（EDSS 2 分），左侧侧脑室旁见环形强化病灶，治疗 35 天后强化消失。再约 9 个月后症状加重并有抑郁表现，MRI 新增 6 个病灶（包括左侧颞叶）；脑脊液报告未见明显异常，没有寡克隆带结果。报告此时诊断为复发缓解型多发性硬化（急性期）。按 2017 年 McDonald 标准及其 2024 年修订，第二次发作时已同时满足空间和时间多发：完成鉴别检查后即可诊断并开始疾病修正治疗。此后的情况没有记录。
conclusion.en: A 26-year-old man had felt dizzy and unwell for over a month. Examination and neurophysiology showed no clear abnormality (EDSS 0; BP 110/65 mmHg, temperature 36.9 °C), routine tests were unremarkable, and MRI showed only a punctate cervical cord signal without clear enhancement. About ten months later he had weakness, blurred vision and reduced hearing (EDSS 2) with a ring-enhancing left periventricular lesion; its enhancement had gone after 35 days of treatment. About nine months later his symptoms worsened with depressive features and six new lesions appeared, including the left temporal lobe; the CSF was reported unremarkable without oligoclonal band results. The report then diagnosed relapsing–remitting multiple sclerosis in an acute phase. Under the 2017 McDonald criteria and their 2024 revision the second episode already met dissemination in space and time: once mimics were excluded, diagnosis and disease-modifying therapy could have come then. Nothing later is recorded.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 首诊：非特异的头晕、查体正常（EDSS 0）、只有一个颈髓点状病灶——没有典型发作，也只占一个部位：随访，不贴标签。
keyReasoning.en: First visit: non-specific dizziness, a normal examination (EDSS 0) and a single punctate cord lesion — no typical attack and one region only: follow him up, don't label him.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 约 10 个月后：新的症状加上新的脑室旁强化病灶，与首诊 MRI 相比多了第二个部位和一个新病灶——MRI 上同时满足空间和时间多发。
keyReasoning.en: About ten months later: new symptoms with a new enhancing periventricular lesion add a second region and a lesion the baseline scan did not have — dissemination in space and in time on MRI.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 听力下降和环形强化不典型，视物模糊加脊髓病灶还要与 NMOSD 等鉴别：先查 AQP4/MOG 抗体、脑脊液、眼科和听力，再把它归为多发性硬化、开始相应的药物。
keyReasoning.en: Reduced hearing, ring enhancement and blurred vision are atypical or need a differential: AQP4/MOG antibodies, CSF, eye and hearing tests come before calling it MS and starting MS drugs.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 这次复发要治，但先排查感染；35 天后强化消失只说明这个病灶不再活动，不代表疾病停止。
keyReasoning.en: Treat the relapse, after looking for infection; enhancement gone at 35 days means one lesion is no longer active, not that the disease has stopped.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 再约 9 个月后，6 个新病灶和症状加重证实病程活动；抑郁表现是另一个需要单独评估的问题，包括轻生风险。
keyReasoning.en: About nine months on, six new lesions and worsening symptoms confirm active disease; the depressive features are a second problem with its own assessment, including the risk of suicide.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告；本病例的事实尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明更早开始疾病修正治疗能否避免第三次发作和新增病灶。病例没有记录首诊头晕的性质、各次发作的细节和 EDSS 分项、病灶大小与强化形态、第二次发作所用的治疗、抗体和脑脊液细节、情绪评估以及远期结局；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report; the facts in this case have not yet been checked against the full article. It cannot show whether earlier disease-modifying therapy would have prevented the third episode or the new lesions. The nature of the first dizziness, the details and EDSS sub-scores of each episode, lesion size and ring pattern, the treatment given at the second episode, antibody and CSF details, any mood assessment and the long-term outcome are not recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 首诊头晕的性质、发作方式和诱因，当时有无听力、视力或肢体症状，以及 EDSS 0 的分项。
unknowns.en: The character, pattern and triggers of the first dizziness, any hearing, visual or limb symptoms then, and the sub-scores behind EDSS 0.

unknowns.zh-CN: 首诊 MRI 的细节（颈髓病灶的节段、大小和序列表现，是否检查了全脊髓）、神经电生理的具体项目，以及常规化验的项目和数值。
unknowns.en: Details of the first MRI (the cord lesion's level, size and sequences; whether the whole spine was imaged), which neurophysiological tests were done, and the routine blood tests' items and values.

unknowns.zh-CN: 第二次发作的起病和经过、乏力的性质（肢体无力还是疲乏）、哪只眼和哪侧耳、有无发热或感染、EDSS 2 的分项，以及病灶大小、强化环形态、占位效应和弥散表现。
unknowns.en: The onset and course of the second episode, what the weakness was (limb weakness or fatigue), which eye and which ear, any fever or infection, the sub-scores behind EDSS 2, and the lesion's size, ring pattern, mass effect and diffusion.

unknowns.zh-CN: 第二次发作后 35 天治疗所用的药物、剂量和途径，以及他的临床反应。
unknowns.en: The drug, dose and route of the 35 days of treatment after the second episode, and his clinical response.

unknowns.zh-CN: 第三次发作具体哪些症状加重、当时的 EDSS、抑郁表现的程度和有无轻生念头，以及其余 5 个新病灶的位置和是否强化。
unknowns.en: Which symptoms worsened at the third episode, the EDSS then, how severe the depressive features were and whether he had suicidal thoughts, and where the other five new lesions lay and whether any enhanced.

unknowns.zh-CN: 脑脊液检查的时间和细节（细胞数、蛋白、IgG 指数、寡克隆带、κ 游离轻链指数），以及 AQP4-IgG、MOG-IgG、眼科和听力检查。
unknowns.en: When the CSF was taken and its details (cell count, protein, IgG index, oligoclonal bands, kappa free light chain index), and AQP4-IgG, MOG-IgG, eye and hearing tests.

unknowns.zh-CN: 既往史、用药、过敏史、家族史，以及吸烟等社会史。
unknowns.en: Past history, medicines, allergies, family history and social history such as smoking.

unknowns.zh-CN: 诊断后的长期治疗、复发、残疾进展和随访结局。
unknowns.en: Long-term treatment, further relapses, disability and follow-up after the diagnosis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 按现行标准读连续 MRI。2017 年 McDonald 标准（Lancet Neurol 2018）及其 2024 年修订（Lancet Neurol 2025）：空间多发 = 至少 2 个特征部位（脑室旁、皮质/近皮质、幕下、脊髓，2024 年新增视神经）各有 ≥ 1 个病灶；时间多发 = 随访 MRI 上与基线相比的新 T2 或强化病灶（不论基线检查做于何时），也可由脑脊液特异性寡克隆带替代（2024 年起也可用 κ 游离轻链指数）。NICE NG220 在 2026 年的修订中也改用 2024 年标准。记录与现行做法：到第二次发作时，他的 MRI 已同时满足两者，而报告的诊断记录在第三次发作之后。
teachingPoints.en: Read serial MRI by today's criteria. 2017 McDonald criteria (Lancet Neurol 2018) and their 2024 revision (Lancet Neurol 2025): dissemination in space = ≥ 1 lesion in at least two characteristic regions (periventricular, cortical/juxtacortical, infratentorial, spinal cord; the optic nerve added in 2024); dissemination in time = a new T2 or enhancing lesion on follow-up MRI against a baseline scan, whenever that was done, for which CSF-specific oligoclonal bands can substitute (from 2024 also the kappa free light chain index). NICE NG220 moved to the 2024 criteria in its 2026 amendment. Then and now: by the second episode his scans already met both, yet the report's diagnosis is recorded only after the third episode.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 标准是怎么变过来的。报告采用的是 2005 年修订的条款。2010 年修订（Ann Neurol 2011）把 2005 年按 Barkhof 病灶计数判断空间多发的做法，简化为 4 个部位中至少 2 个各有 ≥ 1 个 T2 病灶，并接受随访 MRI 上的新病灶（不论基线检查做于何时）作为时间多发；此后的 2017 年标准和 2024 年修订都以此为基础。等到第三次发作才诊断，符合旧的计数思路；今天在第二次发作时要回答的，是有没有其他疾病能更好地解释全部表现。
teachingPoints.en: How the criteria changed. The report applied the 2005 revision. The 2010 revision (Ann Neurol 2011) replaced its Barkhof lesion counts for dissemination in space with ≥ 1 T2 lesion in at least two of four regions, and accepted a new lesion on follow-up MRI, whenever the baseline scan was done, as dissemination in time — the basis of the 2017 criteria and the 2024 revision. A diagnosis made only after a third episode fits the older counting; today the question at the second episode is whether anything else explains the whole picture better.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 诊断多发性硬化之前先排除相似疾病。视物模糊加脊髓病灶要查 AQP4-IgG（2015 年 NMOSD 国际共识强烈推荐细胞法）和 MOG-IgG（2023 年国际 MOGAD 标准的核心条件）——部分多发性硬化免疫治疗（如 β 干扰素、那他珠单抗、芬戈莫德）可使 NMOSD 加重；听力下降在多发性硬化中少见，要客观测听（Susac 综合征同时有听力下降、视觉症状和脑白质病灶）；环形强化要结合大小、强化环形态、占位效应和弥散判断，不完整的开环更支持脱髓鞘。本病例没有记录抗体、眼科和听力结果，也没有记录这些影像特征。
teachingPoints.en: Exclude the mimics before diagnosing MS. Blurred vision with a cord lesion calls for AQP4-IgG — by cell-based assay, as the 2015 international NMOSD criteria strongly recommend — and MOG-IgG, the core of the 2023 International MOGAD Panel criteria; some MS immunotherapies (interferon beta, natalizumab, fingolimod) can make NMOSD worse. Reduced hearing is uncommon in MS and needs audiometry (Susac syndrome combines hearing loss, visual symptoms and white-matter lesions); ring enhancement is judged by size, ring pattern, mass effect and diffusion, an open ring favouring demyelination. The case records none of the antibody, eye or hearing results, nor those imaging features.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 复发的治疗：NICE NG220（2022）对影响日常活动的复发，在起病 14 天内给予甲泼尼龙 0.5 g 口服、每日 1 次、共 5 天；口服无效、不耐受或需住院（严重复发，或需监测躯体或心理情况）时考虑 1 g 静脉、每日 1 次、共 3–5 天；不用更低的剂量，也不给备用激素在家自行服用。先排查感染，以免把假性复发当作复发。激素加快恢复，但不是疾病修正治疗。记录与现行做法：本病例只记录“治疗 35 天后强化消失”，没有记录药名和剂量；强化消失只说明该病灶不再活动——约 9 个月后又出现 6 个新病灶。
teachingPoints.en: Relapse treatment: NICE NG220 (2022) offers methylprednisolone 0.5 g orally once daily for 5 days, within 14 days of onset, for a relapse that affects daily activities, considers 1 g IV once daily for 3–5 days when oral steroids fail or are not tolerated or admission is needed (a severe relapse, or medical or psychological monitoring), and rules out lower doses and standby supplies for home use. Look for infection first so that a pseudo-relapse is not treated as a relapse. Steroids speed recovery; they do not modify the disease. Then and now: this case records only that the enhancement had resolved after 35 days of treatment, not the drug or dose — and that meant only that one lesion was quiet: about nine months later six new lesions appeared.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 确诊后尽早开始疾病修正治疗：ECTRIMS/EAN 指南（Mult Scler 2018）主张活动性复发型多发性硬化（临床复发或 MRI 活动）尽早开始治疗，按疾病活动度、安全性和患者意愿共同选择，并结合临床和 MRI 监测疗效。用药前先有 AQP4-IgG 结果，并完成所选药物要求的筛查。记录与现行做法：本病例没有记录任何长期治疗；按现行标准，第二次发作时就应开始讨论治疗。
teachingPoints.en: After the diagnosis, early disease-modifying therapy: the ECTRIMS/EAN guideline (Mult Scler 2018) favours starting early in active relapsing MS (clinical relapses or MRI activity), choosing with the patient by disease activity, safety and preference, and monitoring response clinically and with MRI. Have the AQP4-IgG result and the chosen drug's pre-treatment screening first. Then and now: this case records no long-term treatment; by today's criteria the discussion would have started at the second episode.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 情绪同样是诊疗的一部分。NICE CG91（2009）要求对慢性躯体疾病患者保持对抑郁的警觉，可用两个问题筛查，并始终直接询问抑郁患者有无轻生念头和意图；回答含糊不能当作没有，并按风险安排治疗和随访。大剂量激素本身也可能影响情绪。记录与现行做法：本病例记录了第三次发作时的抑郁表现，但没有记录评估或处理。
teachingPoints.en: Mood is part of the care. NICE CG91 (2009) asks clinicians to stay alert to depression in people with a chronic physical health problem, to consider two screening questions, and always to ask a person with depression directly about suicidal ideation and intent; treat a vague answer as unresolved and arrange treatment and follow-up by risk. High-dose steroids can themselves affect mood. Then and now: this case records depressive features at the third episode but no assessment or treatment.

testUtterances.text: 您好，今天过来是因为哪儿不得劲？
头晕到现在有多少天了？
晕起来是房子在转，还是人发飘？
是一阵阵地晕，还是整天都晕？
一转脑袋或者从床上起来会不会晕得更厉害？
耳朵嗡嗡响吗，看东西有没有重影？
胳膊腿有没有发麻或者没劲儿？
以前有过眼睛一下子看不清、过几天又好了的情况吗？
晕之前有没有着凉发烧？
平时有啥慢性病没有，住过院吗？
对哪种药过敏不？
你家里人有没有得过神经上的病？
烟抽得多不多？
这回又是哪儿不对劲了？
是哪只眼睛看不清楚？
最近有没有发烧，或者小便的时候疼？
上回那个头晕现在还晕不晕？
上次犯病以后给你用过什么药？
最近心里是不是挺憋屈、不开心？
有没有过不想活了的念头？
你们医院停车方便吗？
So what's been bothering you — what made you come in?
How many weeks have you had this dizziness for?
Does the room spin round, or do you just feel woozy?
When it happens, any trouble with your hearing or your eyesight?
Have your arms or legs gone numb or weak at all?
Did you have a fever or a viral illness beforehand?
Are you on any regular tablets?
Anything you're allergic to?
So what's going on this time round?
Have you had a temperature or any waterworks trouble lately?
Which eye is blurry, and does it ache when you look around?
How have things been since your last episode?
How's your mood been — have you been feeling down?
Have you had any thoughts of ending it all?
Are you on anything to stop further attacks?
Do you mind if I open the window?
Is it all right if I sit here?
